subject: Demo recap & proposed POC plan - Finovate Bank
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finovatebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@finovatebank.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap & next steps (POC)

Hi Marissa 

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. The team and I appreciated the clear walkthrough of Redwood's serving performance and the routing features. We discussed internally and think a short POC would help us validate latency and cost assumptions for a customer-facing recommender use case.

High-level asks from our side:
- Validate end-to-end latency at 512 tokens under expected concurrency (10-20 QPS).
- Verify embedding similarity quality for our re-ranking flows (we'll provide 1k queries + gold labels).
- Confirm cost estimate per 1M tokens with the recommended batching/quant profile.

Can you share a proposed POC plan (success criteria, timeline, owners, and any network/infra requirements)? Evan and I are aiming to kick off in the first week of April if possible.

Thanks 
Priya Shah
Director, ML Engineering
Finovate Bank

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finovatebank.com>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@finovatebank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap & next steps (POC)

Hi Priya / Evan 

Great to hear you're interested in a POC. Below is a proposed outline we discussed internally. I've looped in Rishi (sales) for commercial timeline, Dev for technical scoping, and Naomi from CS to support onboarding/metrics.

Proposed POC (3 weeks)  objectives & owners:
1) Success criteria (pass/fail metrics)  owner: Finovate + Redwood
   - 95th percentile tail latency <= 300ms for 512-token requests at target concurrency (10 QPS sustained)
   - Embedding re-ranking NDCG lift >= 8% vs baseline on your gold set
   - Cost within 20% of our forecasted per-1M-token estimate (we'll provide detailed calc)

2) Evaluation plan  owner: Finovate (data) + Redwood (run/eval)
   - Week 0 (prep): exchange test dataset (1k queries + labels), grant test credentials and network access, baseline run on your current stack
   - Week 1: Redwood hosted POC run (demo environment)  measure latency + quality; run embedding batch and re-rank tests
   - Week 2: Iteration  tweak batching/quantization profile, run second evaluation; produce final metrics and cost breakdown
   - Week 3: Wrap-up call, handoff plan and recommended prod configuration

3) Timeline & milestones  owner: Marissa / Priya
   - Kickoff: week of 4/4 (one-hour kickoff, align SSO/network)
   - Data exchange complete: 4/6
   - First evaluation run: 4/10
   - Final results + debrief: 4/21

4) Technical & network requirements (high level)  owner: Dev
   - Short-lived API key + IP allowlist, TLS, 256-bit encryption in transit
   - Sample network egress test and firewall rules (see attached network-requirements.pdf)
   - Optional: we can run in your VPC if you prefer (private deployment timeline longer)

Attachments: redwood-poc-scope.pdf (POC scope + roles), network-requirements.pdf

Next steps I suggest:
- Confirm kickoff week of 4/4 and attendees
- Share test data and a point-of-contact for SRE/network
- I'll get Rishi to share a short order form / trial credits and Naomi will prepare a success-metrics tracker for the evaluation

Thanks  looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finovatebank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed POC plan - technical notes / checklist

Hi Priya 

Quick technical notes and checklist from our side to make the Week 0->1 transition smooth. I'm attaching a short implementation checklist (redwood-poc-implementation-checklist.xlsx) and the network requirements PDF referenced by Marissa.

Key asks for your infra/SRE team:
- Provide a CIDR or static IPs to add to our allowlist (or confirm you'll use our temporary keys and IP filtering)
- Share a sample of the 1k queries in JSONL (one query per line) and the label file (CSV)
- If you want embedding dimensionality fixed, confirm model+dim preference (we usually recommend the 1536-d open model for ranking use cases)
- Any rate-limiting rules we should be aware of during the evaluation window

We will:
- Provision a short-lived sandbox API key tied to the deal (expires after POC)
- Run baseline and optimized runs, export logs and token-level cost breakdowns for you

If you can assign an SRE and a data owner for these items by 4/1 we can meet the kickoff timeline.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-poc-implementation-checklist.xlsx, network-requirements.pdf

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finovatebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@finovatebank.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@finovatebank.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed POC plan - confirmation and procurement

Thanks Marissa / Dev  this looks good and aligns with what we discussed on the call.

We can do kickoff the week of 4/4. I'll assign SRE (Rajiv) and our data owner (Evan) to the items Dev listed  Rajiv, Evan, copying you on this thread.

One commercial/ops note: our procurement/legal team will need a short trial/order form and a statement of work or pilot agreement to process the trial credits (our procurement lead is CC'd). Can Rishi or someone share that doc?

Also attaching a small baseline dataset sample (we'll share the full 1k by 4/1).

If we can get the sandbox credentials and network allowlist before 4/4, we should be on track.

Best,
Priya Shah
Director, ML Engineering
Finovate Bank
attachments: baseline_sample.jsonl
